g.text: Title: Haptic bracelet - charger and regulated supply

g.desc: Title: Haptic bracelet - charger and regulated supply

g.text: One wrist / ring pod schematic draft

g.desc: One wrist / ring pod schematic draft

fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;
fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;

g.text: 22u additional bulk on each POD_3V3 branch.

g.desc: 22u additional bulk on each POD_3V3 branch.

g.text: Battery protection is external to these PCBs.

g.desc: Battery protection is external to these PCBs.

g.text: J3 pin 3: pack NTC to pin 4, selected for U11 TS profile.

g.desc: J3 pin 3: pack NTC to pin 4, selected for U11 TS profile.

g.text: Additional cell sensors are on pod sheets.

g.desc: Additional cell sensors are on pod sheets.

g.text: NTC selection and charging supervision firmware remain open.

g.desc: NTC selection and charging supervision firmware remain open.

g.text: Factory PCM stays on every battery. No central protector.

g.desc: Factory PCM stays on every battery. No central protector.

g.text: Each PACK+ -> local fuse -> VBAT; PACK- -> GND.

g.desc: Each PACK+ -> local fuse -> VBAT; PACK- -> GND.

g.text: VBAT connects directly to U11 BAT and stays live in ship mode.

g.desc: VBAT connects directly to U11 BAT and stays live in ship mode.

g.text: 720mAh nominal; 360mA continuous total with equal sharing.

g.desc: 720mAh nominal; 360mA continuous total with equal sharing.

g.text: USB input is current-limited on the USB-C sheet. U11 power path supplies SYS from USB or the protected battery.

g.desc: USB input is current-limited on the USB-C sheet. U11 power path supplies SYS from USB or the protected battery.

g.text: U11 /CE is pulled to SYS; Q1 must be enabled to charge.

g.desc: U11 /CE is pulled to SYS; Q1 must be enabled to charge.

g.text: Set cell voltage/current/termination and temperature policy first.

g.desc: Set cell voltage/current/termination and temperature policy first.

g.text: Keep SYS regulation at 4.5 V. No 5.5 V/pass-through setting.

g.desc: Keep SYS regulation at 4.5 V. No 5.5 V/pass-through setting.

g.text: Firmware must handle charger reset/watchdog and USB suspend.

g.desc: Firmware must handle charger reset/watchdog and USB suspend.

g.text: Place L1, input and output capacitors tight to U12.

g.desc: Place L1, input and output capacitors tight to U12.

g.text: Keep FB and its return away from L1/L2 switching nodes.

g.desc: Keep FB and its return away from L1/L2 switching nodes.
